# <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="../icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> Color Ramp

<p class="hdue-node-type">VOP node · <code>hdue::substrate_color_ramp::1.3</code></p>

Maps a float to a color through a ramp (a UE curve in the material's curve atlas), for example density to smoke color.
{ .hdue-node-summary }

It is part of an hdUE Substrate Material Builder graph, which hdUE prepares into a UE Substrate material; it does not run as a VEX or MaterialX shader.

## Inputs

Value
:   Position on the ramp, from 0 to 1.

## Parameters

Value
:   Position on the ramp, from 0 to 1.

    `value` · Default 0

Ramp
:   The ramp. Editing it recompiles the material.

    `ramp`
